no aaa root
!
username admin privilege 15 role network-admin secret sha512 $6$BfyQeqMEAOYfFIFW$2TgamS6RUy/xvOEvKUwPWTVOBo3/XKjMOv0OJc1jq0e5avT1XGjkSpRvtprKpxM3u/HbtqsRiDweed98L7PYS.
!
no service interface inactive port-id allocation disabled
!
transceiver qsfp default-mode 4x10G
!
service routing protocols model multi-agent
!
hostname r4
!
spanning-tree mode mstp
!
system l1
   unsupported speed action error
   unsupported error-correction action error
!
interface Ethernet1
   description eBGP-vers-r3-AS65001
   no switchport
   ip address 172.16.34.2/30
   ipv6 address 2001:db8:34::3/127
   ip ospf area 0.0.0.0
   ospfv3 passive-interface
   ospfv3 ipv6 area 0.0.0.0
!
interface Ethernet2
   description vers-r5
   no switchport
   ip address 10.2.45.1/30
   ipv6 address 2001:db8:2:45::2/127
   ip ospf network point-to-point
   ip ospf authentication message-digest
   ip ospf area 0.0.0.0
   ip ospf message-digest-key 1 md5 7 Xa3hY/loCKnuF1M4pSYh4fkunbQLFopl
   ospfv3 network point-to-point
   ospfv3 ipv6 area 0.0.0.0
!
interface Loopback0
   ip address 10.2.255.4/32
   ipv6 address 2001:db8:2:ff::4/128
   ip ospf area 0.0.0.0
   ospfv3 passive-interface
   ospfv3 ipv6 area 0.0.0.0
!
interface Management0
   ip address 172.20.22.14/24
!
ip routing
!
ip prefix-list PL-EBGP-IN seq 10 permit 10.1.0.0/16
ip prefix-list PL-EBGP-IN seq 20 permit 192.168.1.0/24
ip prefix-list PL-EBGP-OUT seq 10 permit 10.2.0.0/16
ip prefix-list PL-EBGP-OUT seq 20 permit 192.168.2.0/24
!
ipv6 prefix-list PL6-EBGP-IN
   seq 10 permit 2001:db8:1::/48
   seq 20 permit 2001:db8:a1::/64
!
ipv6 prefix-list PL6-EBGP-OUT
   seq 10 permit 2001:db8:2::/48
   seq 20 permit 2001:db8:a2::/64
!
ipv6 unicast-routing
!
ip route 10.2.0.0/16 Null0
!
ipv6 route 2001:db8:2::/48 Null0
!
route-map RM-EBGP-IN permit 10
   match ip address prefix-list PL-EBGP-IN
!
route-map RM-EBGP-OUT permit 10
   match ip address prefix-list PL-EBGP-OUT
!
route-map RM6-EBGP-IN permit 10
   match ipv6 address prefix-list PL6-EBGP-IN
!
route-map RM6-EBGP-OUT permit 10
   match ipv6 address prefix-list PL6-EBGP-OUT
!
router bgp 65002
   router-id 10.2.255.4
   neighbor 172.16.34.1 remote-as 65001
   neighbor 172.16.34.1 description r3-AS65001
   neighbor 172.16.34.1 ttl maximum-hops 1
   neighbor 172.16.34.1 route-map RM-EBGP-IN in
   neighbor 172.16.34.1 route-map RM-EBGP-OUT out
   neighbor 172.16.34.1 password 7 tYPpD4pAb7WtlAdSelrqsg==
   neighbor 172.16.34.1 maximum-routes 10
   neighbor 2001:db8:34::2 remote-as 65001
   neighbor 2001:db8:34::2 description r3-AS65001-v6
   neighbor 2001:db8:34::2 ttl maximum-hops 1
   neighbor 2001:db8:34::2 password 7 mMDqN3bMXeF5X8whHdx9rOHay2y5HbGg
   neighbor 2001:db8:34::2 maximum-routes 10
   !
   address-family ipv4
      no neighbor 2001:db8:34::2 activate
      network 10.2.0.0/16
      network 192.168.2.0/24
   !
   address-family ipv6
      neighbor 2001:db8:34::2 activate
      neighbor 2001:db8:34::2 route-map RM6-EBGP-IN in
      neighbor 2001:db8:34::2 route-map RM6-EBGP-OUT out
      network 2001:db8:2::/48
      network 2001:db8:a2::/64
!

   ipv4
      software-forwarding kernel
   !
   ipv6
      software-forwarding kernel
!

   router-id 10.2.255.4
   passive-interface Ethernet1
   passive-interface Loopback0
   redistribute bgp
   max-lsa 12000
!
router ospfv3
   router-id 10.2.255.4
   !
   address-family ipv6
      redistribute bgp
!
